author: artlbv
body:
### PR description

Seeds of the Phase-2 GT `step1_2024` menu no longer clone the object definitions and no
longer convert offline thresholds to online ones in python. Objects and pT scalings become
top-level PSets that conditions reference via `refToPSet_`, together with the offline
threshold:

```python
SingleTkMuon22 = l1tGTSingleObjectCond.clone(
    object = gt_ref("l1tGTtkMuonVLoose"),
    offlineMinPt = cms.double(22),
)
```

A dumped menu (e.g. for ConfDB) therefore keeps objects, scalings and offline thresholds
editable in one place instead of repeating them in every seed.

* `L1GTObjectConfig.h` (new) resolves the structured form into the flat one  object merge,
  collection-level overrides, offlineonline thresholds  and is used by
  `L1GTSingleCollectionCut` and `L1GTAlgoBlockProducer`. **The old flat form keeps working**;
  cut descriptions no longer insert defaults, so a default at the collection level cannot
  silently override a value of the referenced object.
* `L1GTOfflineThreshold.h` (new) does the offlineonline conversion, identical to python's
  `round(x, 1)`, and is exported through pybind as `offlineToOnlinePt`.
* `l1tGTMenuTools.flattenGTMenu()` (new) does the same flattening in python, for tools that
  inspect the configuration directly (e.g. the VHDL firmware writer).
* `scripts/dumpL1TGTMenu.py` (structured or `--flat`), `test/compareGTMenuDumps.py` and
  `test/testL1TGTMenuTools.py` (new, registered in `test/BuildFile.xml`).

No change of emulator behaviour is intended: only the structure of the configuration changes.

### Validation

Tested in `CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-09-29-2300` (`el9_amd64_gcc14`) against an unpatched area of the
same IB. The IB contains this branch's base, so `git cms-merge-topic` brings in only the 19
files of this PR.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `scram b -j 8`, `scram b code-checks`, `scram b code-format` | clean, no errors or warnings |
| `testL1TGTMenuTools` (`scram b runtests`) | 7/7 pass |
| `offlineToOnlinePt(22, 1.8, 1.0)` | `20.2`; C++ and python `round(x,1)` agree on 20000/20000 random points |
| `edmPluginHelp -p L1GTDoubleObjectCond` | optional `object`, `ptScaling`, `offlineMinPt`, `offlineMinScalarSumPt` on both collections |
| `compareGTMenuDumps.py` old dump vs new structured / new `--flat` | 45 conditions, 42 paths, **0 differences** both ways |
| **Emulator A/B**, `-s L1P2GT` on 500 PU200 TTbar events (`RelValTTbar_14TeV` PU D128, `pre3`), single-threaded, identical cfg | 40 algorithms: **0/20000** mismatches in `decisionBeforeBxMaskAndPrescale`, `decisionBeforePrescale`, `decisionFinal` and in the triggered-object indices |
| Same runs, per-filter `P2GTCandidateVectorRef` products | 60 products x 500 events: **0/30000** mismatches, all 60 non-empty at least once |
| CPU / RSS | 48.22 s / 1725 MB vs 48.33 s / 1725 MB |
| Misconfiguration | `offlineMinPt` + `regionsMinPt`, an offline threshold without any `ptScaling`, and a `ptScaling` whose region count differs from `regionsAbsEtaLowerBounds` each throw `Configuration` at construction with an explicit message; a correct structured config constructs and only fails on missing input products |
| VHDL firmware writer (`ozormpa/VHDLWriter_CMSSW_15_0_0_pre3`, `add_cuts`) with `flattenGTMenu()` | all 18 pybind methods it needs exist; generated VHDL identical to the writer's output on the pre-refactor menu (1524 lines; only three `-- Physical value:` comments differ, `25` vs `25.0`)  note the writer is non-deterministic run to run unless `PYTHONHASHSEED` is pinned, independently of this PR |

Per-algorithm pass counts over the 500 events are non-trivial (e.g. `pDoublePuppiJet112_112`
226, `pSingleTkEle36` 130, `pDoubleTkMuon_4p5_4p5_OS_Er2_Mass7to18` 1), so the agreement is
not the all-zero kind.

Two follow-up commits in this PR came out of that validation: `scram b code-format` on the new
headers, and taking the input tag through `l1t::collectionTag()` so that a condition defining
neither `tag` nor `object` still gets an explicit message rather than
`MissingParameter: Parameter 'tag' not found.` (a side effect of making `tag` optional in the
description).



### Status

Opened as a draft for early feedback on the approach, not yet for integration. Rebased
onto master (fb7e0ddfaf2) and conflict-free. The one conflict, in
`SeedDefinitions/step1_2024/l1tGTMenu_BTagSeeds_cff.py` against 0d2c607acc5 ("Correct pt
thresholds in triple muon seed to match name and standalone tools"), was resolved by
keeping the corrected 3.5/2.5 thresholds in the restructured form. Checked by dumping the
step1_2024 menu from master and from this branch and comparing after
`flattenGTMenu`: 45 conditions on both sides, none differing.

The last commit follows b1c1e194a90 ("Update the scalings to AR26 values"), which moved
`SingleTkMuon22.regionsMinPt[2]` from 20.3 to 20.4; master alone yields the same value, so
no threshold is changed by this branch.
title: [L1T] P2GT menus: reference shared object/scaling PSets from seeds (ConfDB-friendly)
